task.title: Change the water
task.shortdesc: Keep cut flowers fresh by replacing vase water.

context.p: Use room-temperature water unless your variety card says otherwise.

step.cmd: Lift the stems out of the and set them on a clean towel.
Empty the vase and rinse it.
Refill, recut stems at an angle, and return them to the vase.

result.p: Clouded water is gone and stems can drink again.
